en: n. a path through the countryside; a line of marks left behind by someone or something; a series of things following; v. to follow behind someone or something; to be losing in a competition; to pull something along behind you
ex: We followed a trail through the forest to the waterfall.
我們沿著森林小徑走到瀑布。

en: n. a small round piece of glass, wood or plastic with a hole for putting on a thread; a small drop of liquid; v. to form drops; to decorate with beads
ex: She made a bracelet out of colorful beads.
她用彩色珠子做了一條手鍊。

en: help and advice that is given to someone, especially by someone in authority; the act of leading or directing something
ex: Students receive guidance from their teachers about choosing a career.
學生在選擇職業方面得到老師的指導。

en: n. a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest; a. relating to tourism
ex: Thousands of tourists visit this temple every year.
每年有數千名遊客造訪這座廟。

en: a. having the ability or qualities necessary to do something; skilled and efficient
ex: She is a capable manager who gets things done.
她是一位能幹的經理，總能把事情完成。

en: n. a ball of air or gas in a liquid or soap; a sudden growth in prices that cannot continue; v. to produce bubbles; to be full of strong feelings
ex: The children were blowing soap bubbles in the garden.
孩子們在花園裡吹肥皂泡泡。

en: n. a continuous dull pain in a part of the body; v. to feel a continuous dull pain; to want something very much
ex: I have a terrible ache in my back after sitting all day.
我坐了一整天，背痛得要命。

en: a. existing at the beginning; not copied from something else; new and different; n. the first form of something from which copies are made
ex: The original plan was to open the shop in March.
最初的計畫是在三月開店。

en: the process of getting ready for something or making something ready; (preparations) things that you do to get ready for something
ex: The students are busy with preparation for the final exam.
學生們正忙著準備期末考。

en: a. likely to happen or to be true; (n.) a person or thing that is likely to win or be chosen
ex: It is probable that the meeting will be postponed.
會議很可能會延期。

en: n. the gray or black powder that is left after something has burned; a type of tree with hard wood
ex: He tapped the ash from his cigarette into the tray.
他把菸灰彈進菸灰缸裡。

en: a large green or brown insect with long back legs that jumps and makes a loud noise by rubbing its legs together
ex: A grasshopper jumped onto the leaf.
一隻蚱蜢跳到了葉子上。

en: n. a line of light shining from something; a long thick piece of wood or metal supporting a roof; a wide happy smile; v. to smile very happily; to send out light or signals
ex: A beam of sunlight came through the curtains.
一道陽光從窗簾縫隙照了進來。

en: a. (of food or other substances) bad and no longer able to be eaten; (informal) very bad or unpleasant; morally bad
ex: Throw away that rotten apple before it ruins the others.
把那顆爛蘋果丟掉，免得其他的也跟著壞掉。

en: a game in which players roll a heavy ball along a smooth wooden track toward a group of pins to knock them down
ex: We go bowling every Friday night.
我們每週五晚上都去打保齡球。

en: n. a piece of paper or cloth attached to something that gives information about it; a name or word used to describe someone; a company that makes music; v. to attach a label to something; to describe someone as a particular type
ex: Check the label to see how the shirt should be washed.
看看標籤上寫的洗滌方式。

en: n. praise or approval for something you have done; an arrangement to buy now and pay later; a unit of study in a course; the belief that someone is honest; v. to give someone praise; to add money to an account
ex: She deserves credit for finishing the project on time.
她準時完成專案，功勞應歸於她。

en: n. a position in a group; a line of people or things; a level in an organization such as the army; a. (of plants) growing too thickly; having a strong unpleasant smell; complete (used for emphasis); v. to put someone or something in a position; to hold a position
ex: He rose through the ranks to become a general.
他一路從基層晉升為將軍。

en: a. not smooth or even; not gentle; approximate or not exact; difficult or unpleasant; feeling ill; n. the longer grass on a golf course; a first draft; v. to make something rough
ex: The road to the village is rough and full of stones.
通往村子的路崎嶇不平，滿是石頭。

en: adv. in spite of something else; used when you want to change the subject; in any case; carelessly
ex: It might rain tomorrow, but we will go to the park anyhow.
明天可能下雨，不過我們還是會去公園。

en: to make the sound of a word or letter; to say something officially or formally; to state an opinion firmly
ex: How do you pronounce this word?
這個字怎麼唸？

en: a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures
ex: The carpenter built a new door for our house.
木匠幫我們家做了一扇新門。

en: v. to calculate the result of adding a number to itself a particular number of times; to increase or make something increase in number; to breed
ex: If you multiply four by five, you get twenty.
四乘以五等於二十。

en: n. the ability to see; the ability to think about the future with imagination and wisdom; something that you imagine or dream; v. to imagine or see something in your mind
ex: He has a clear vision of what he wants the company to become.
他對公司未來的樣貌有清晰的願景。

en: a. as much as is needed; enough for a particular purpose
ex: We don't have sufficient time to finish the work.
我們沒有足夠的時間完成這項工作。

en: n. the activity of moving goods or people from one place to another; a vehicle or system used for this; a strong emotion; v. to move goods or people from one place to another
ex: Public transport in the city is cheap and convenient.
這座城市的大眾運輸既便宜又方便。

en: a. having the usual qualities of a particular kind of person, thing or group; showing the normal characteristics of something
ex: This is a typical example of traditional Taiwanese architecture.
這是傳統台灣建築的典型範例。

en: a. not cooked; in its natural state and not yet treated or made into anything; (of skin) red and painful; (of weather) cold and wet; n. a sore area of skin
ex: Sushi is made with raw fish.
壽司是用生魚片做的。

en: a. feeling, showing or causing great happiness; full of joy
ex: The joyful children sang and danced in the garden.
快樂的孩子們在花園裡又唱又跳。

en: v. to lose blood from the body; to lose color; to take money from someone gradually; (of a color) to run into another color; (of plants) to lose sap
ex: His nose started to bleed after he was hit by the ball.
他被球打到後鼻子開始流血。

en: n. a period of time spent away from work, school or home for rest or travel; a break from school or work; (US) a holiday
ex: We are going on vacation to Japan next month.
我們下個月要去日本度假。

en: a. far away in distance or time; (of a place) far from other places; very small or slight; (of a person) not friendly or interested
ex: They live in a remote village in the mountains.
他們住在山裡的一個偏遠村落。

en: n. a person who flies an aircraft; a person who guides a ship into a harbor; a test version of something; v. to fly an aircraft; to guide something; to test something on a small scale
ex: The pilot announced that we would land in twenty minutes.
機長廣播說我們二十分鐘後降落。

en: n. a small wooden house in a forest or the mountains; a room on a ship or plane for passengers; the part of an aircraft where the passengers sit; v. to confine in a small space
ex: We spent the weekend in a log cabin by the lake.
我們在湖邊的木屋度過了週末。

en: n. a small flat computer with a touch screen; a small round or flat piece of medicine; a flat piece of stone or metal with writing on it; a pad of paper
ex: He takes one tablet twice a day after meals.
他每天飯後各服用一錠藥。

en: n. a sweet that you chew but do not swallow; the firm pink flesh around the teeth; a sticky substance from some trees; glue; v. to stick things together with glue
ex: Please don't chew gum in class.
上課時請不要嚼口香糖。

en: adv. for that reason; as a result of what has just been said
ex: He broke the rules and therefore he was punished.
他違反規定，因此受到處罰。

en: a sweet food served at the end of a meal, such as cake, ice cream or fruit
ex: What would you like for dessert, cake or ice cream?
你想吃什麼甜點，蛋糕還是冰淇淋？

en: all the words that a person knows or uses; all the words in a language; a list of words with their meanings
ex: Reading a lot will help you build up your vocabulary.
大量閱讀有助於增加你的字彙量。

en: n. a plant such as wheat or rice grown for food; the amount of plants gathered at one time; a very short haircut; v. to cut something short; to grow plants for food; to gather plants
ex: Farmers in this region grow crops such as rice and corn.
這個地區的農民種植稻米和玉米等作物。
